disclaimer: The Cycle na for training and recovery context only. E no be medical advice, e no be diagnostic tool, and you must never use am for contraception or fertility planning. Di predictions na estimate wey come from di dates wey you log.
settings.summaryOn: Dey track · na your own alone
settings.summaryShared: Dey track · you share am with your coach
settings.trackingDesc: Log di first day of your period; Shape go read your phase and di patterns wey dey follow am. Na your own alone unless you share am.
settings.shareDesc: Di coach(es) wey you link go see your phase and di start dates wey just happen — so training and food fit follow your week. You fit off am anytime.
settings.shareOffDesc: E go dey available once cycle tracking dey on.
settings.stopDesc: Dis one go delete every date wey you log and e go stop di sharing. You no fit undo am.
optIn.body: Log di first day of your period and Shape go read di rhythm — where you dey for your cycle, and wetin dey usually show for you for sleep, energy and training.
optIn.privacy: E still na your own. Nothing no dey go to coach unless you turn sharing on, and if you stop am, every date wey you log go delete.
optIn.cta: I understand — make we start tracking
optIn.done: Cycle tracking don dey on — log your last period make e begin.
share.consent: I agree make dem share my cycle phase and di period start dates wey just happen with di coach(es) wey I link. I fit off dis one anytime.
optOut.title: You wan stop tracking make e delete?
optOut.message: Dis one go delete every date wey you log and e go off cycle tracking. If you bin dey share with coach, dat one go stop too. You no fit undo am.
optOut.done: Cycle tracking don stop — your dates don delete.
err.unavailable: Cycle setup never ready. Try again small time.
err.signedOut: Sign in make you start tracking.
err.generic: E no save. Try am again.
paused: Cycle dey run long — predictions don pause.
late: New cycle go start wen you log am.
cal.setupTitle: Log di first day of your last period make e begin.
cal.setupBody: Tap any day wey don pass for di calendar. After two or three cycles, Shape go start to read your pattern.
cal.noFuture: You no fit log date wey never reach.
cal.unlogMessage: Dis one go comot di period start wey you log for dis day.
cal.hint: Tap one day make you log di first day of period. Tap am again make e comot.
card.setup: Log period start make e begin.
card.cycles: {n, plural, one {Data from # cycle} other {Data from # cycle dem}}
